title: Pendulum
overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

title: Rocky Wake
overview: Elise, long estranged from her mother Megan, visits her as she lies on her deathbed. Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

title: Mascara
overview: After his wife's passing, an old man spends one last night in their home—before bidding an unforgettable farewell. Written & directed by Ahmed Said Ağaoğlu. In development.

title: What We Owe to Each Other
overview: Plot unknown.

title: Brujo
overview: Plot unknown.

title: Ātaahua
overview: A lonely man seeks solace in an art gallery, but instead meets the face of death- Hinenui Te Pō

title: Mr. Penguin: The Movie
overview: When unexplained events begin to occur, a hidden presence reveals itself. Silent, watchful, and growing closer—Mr. Penguin is no longer just a mystery.

title: Bleeders
overview: A drug deal with a vampire goes horribly wrong.

title: Toulouse MacDonnell Upcoming project
overview: The story of two detectives in Soho.

title: Starlight & You
overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

title: Nasty
overview: After an injury sidelines Dylan’s ability to train for the Olympics, the determined gymnast must regain the trust of her demanding coach while facing off against a prodigious new competitor threatening to eclipse her place in the spotlight.

title: Honeymoon
overview: When two strangers meet at a seemingly ordinary event, their lives could change forever; stepping into a fairytale romance, with the fragility of their blind love looming above them.

title: The Liberation
overview: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

title: Citric Acid
overview: A young artist is stalked via the internet by a mysterious online celebrity who harshly criticizes their artwork.

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: Children of Blood and Bone
overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

title: The Beekeeper 2
overview: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.

title: River
overview: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

title: The Mirror's Echo
overview: A grieving teen discovers that her deceased twin sister is communicating through her vanity mirror, but the entity reflecting back is far from a sibling.

title: Animals
overview: Still trapped in a doomsday bunker the scientist continues his mission to narrate over footage of the natural world, hoping if animals ever return to this planet they will be cherished.

title: The Alone Boy
overview: The Alone Boy is an upcoming drama-action film directed by Resad Ajim, developed as an emotionally driven cinematic project exploring themes of loneliness, ambition, survival, and personal transformation.  The movie is expected to combine emotional storytelling with intense character development, focusing on the struggles of a young individual navigating isolation and conflict in a changing world.  The film centers around a boy whose life is shaped by emotional hardship, betrayal, and the pressure of survival. As the story progresses, the central character faces challenges involving friendship, trust, family struggles, and the pursuit of identity. The narrative is designed to portray the emotional journey of a person attempting to rise above difficult circumstances while confronting inner fears and external obstacles.

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, Christophe (10) tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: Animal Friends
overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: Air Bud Returns
overview: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

title: Ultrakill
overview: Two adolescent boys get bullied everyday and record everything. While recording not only do they show themselves being bullied but they also chronicle everythint before they go on a killing spree on their town

title: HOMONOMO
overview: Following a devastating rejection, Ethan (Charlie Walker) discovers a mysterious object  that makes him straight.

title: Night of The Abandoned City
overview: A spin-off from the Abandoned city movie focusing on the mysterious man and his son in the night of the Abandoned city

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

title: Karoshi
overview: Described as a corporate thriller with a samurai twist. Set in a Japanese-influenced New York City and features a revenge element. Plot TBA.

title: The Rescue
overview: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

title: Slayground
overview: On the week of Halloween, the primary suspect in a mass murder investigation escapes police custody and goes on the run, attempting to prove his innocence while becoming the target of a massive manhunt.

title: Drag
overview: A routine robbery at a rural house turns into a nightmare for two amateur burglars when one of them throws their back out. Things spiral out of control as they try to make it out before the homeowner returns.

title: Ages of Madness: The Howling of the Jinn
overview: A cosmic horror animated movie.

title: Christmas Angels
overview: During the Christmas season, an unhoused single mother turns to love, play, and imagination to shield her young daughter from the hardship surrounding them, creating moments of wonder in a world that offers them little.
